description: Delete a message by moving it to the account's Trash folder (reversible). Pass permanent: true to delete it permanently instead — DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible; confirm with the user first. Permanent deletion may be disabled for this client.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

permanent.description: Delete permanently instead of moving to Trash (default false)

name: delete_message
